schema.title: Response List Engines Api V1 Engines Get

get.description: List all API keys belonging to the caller's organization (redacted, prefix only).

schema.title: Response List Api Keys Api V1 Api Keys Get

post.description:
Generate a new API key for the authenticated organization.
The raw secret is returned ONLY ONCE upon creation.

Rotate an existing API key:
  - Generates a brand-new key with the same name, environment, and scopes.
  - Either immediately revokes the previous key (grace_period_minutes=0)
    or sets an expiration window for zero-downtime production rotation.

delete.description: Revoke an API key belonging to the caller's organization.

get.description: Return current-month decision quota, consumption, latency, and engine breakdown.
Return daily API request volume and average latency for the requested lookback window.
Return the active verified `manifest/1` specification (public auditor metadata; ETag-cached).
Return published `calibration-report/2` summary (digests, calibrator IDs, ECE bands, audit status; ETag-cached).
Return the append-only hash-chained `keys/1` Ed25519 public key registry (served directly from registry; ETag-cached).

Export a signed `dpl-bundle/1` selective-disclosure audit bundle.
If `presented_state` is supplied, verifies `sha256(utf8_nfc(presented_state)) == state_digest`
without persisting `presented_state`.
